name: Lingua — Conlang Builder
subtitle: Your script, your language
description:
Lingua is where you make a language and then actually use it.

YOUR SCRIPT
Draw each letter with your finger. Lingua compiles your letters into a real font on your phone, and gives you a keyboard with your letters on the keys to type with in the app. You can also build keyboards of any existing characters (accented letters, IPA, symbols, other scripts) and use them in any app, free and as many as you like. Alphabet, abjad, syllabary, abugida or logography, written in any direction. Digits are letters too, in whatever base you choose.

YOUR LANGUAGE
A dictionary where every word has meanings, part of speech, examples, register and origin. Readings and IPA. A phonology page built from what you have written. A grammar of 44 chapters — cases, agreement, word order, negation, questions, derivation — whose rules really conjugate: describe a pattern once and every word in that class follows it. A calendar with your own month and weekday names, a notebook, and CSV import for a list you already have.

A PLACE TO USE IT
A timeline where people post lines in their own languages, in their own letters. Each post carries its letter shapes with it, so anyone can read your script without your font, and every post has a gloss so people can follow and reply even to a language nobody else speaks yet. Replies and threads, following, tags, a daily prompt everyone answers in their language, photos with your letters drawn on them, a 30-second voice clip, and a card that turns one line into a picture to share.

Publish your language's page, and download the alphabet or dictionary of a language you like, to read.

FREE AND PAID
Free: a full a–z and 0–9 script, one language, a dictionary of 100 words, as many keyboards as you like, and the whole timeline. Plus and Pro add more letters, more words and more languages. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled.

promotionalText: Draw your own letters, build the grammar, and post in your language on a timeline where everyone can read your script.
whatsNew:
New
- Drawing: a baseline on the canvas, a stroke width for each line (five sizes), and layers you can name, show or hide.
- The lasso moves only the strokes you select.
- Font export is free on every plan.
- Word generator: one button on the new-word screen fills in everything but the meaning, learned from your dictionary.
- Comma and period are letters you can draw. The bottom row is now ! ? , . space return.
- Line breaks in meanings, examples, notes and your language's overview.
- Build your own keyboard for a language you downloaded.
- Plus can make 3 languages and Pro as many as you like. Download 1 on Free, 3 on Plus, any number on Pro.

Fixed
- Saving could fail with "That did not work."
- Pressing Save sometimes did nothing.
- A letter you erased came back after saving.
- Opening the original word from a derived word's screen crashed.
- "The timeline is full" no longer appears.
- Your own reposts now show on your profile.
- Other fixes and improvements.
